name: Push-Up Plus
steps: Start in a standard push-up position or from your knees, with hands placed directly beneath your shoulders.
Keep your arms completely straight with elbows locked throughout the entire movement.
Allow your chest to sag slightly toward the floor by letting your shoulder blades pinch together.
Push the floor firmly away, rounding your upper back upward toward the ceiling and spreading your shoulder blades as wide as possible.
Hold the peak 'plus' protraction for one second, then slowly lower back into retraction.
coaching_cues: Your elbows must never bend; all movement is pure shoulder blade protraction and retraction.
Imagine pushing the floor away into the basement to spread your shoulder blades apart.
Maintain a rigid core so your hips do not sag.
